title: Titanium Ultrasonic Connecting Stud
alloyReason: Triaxially forged Titanium Ultrasonic Connecting Stud (UNS R56400) is specified for this ultrasonic tooling component where isotropic mechanical properties are mandatory for withstanding multi-axial stress states. The 3D forging process eliminates crystallographic texture directionality, delivering uniform 950 MPa tensile strength and >15% elongation in all three orientations. This is critical for M12x1 where fatigue crack initiation is sensitive to microstructural anisotropy. This rationale is driven by m12x1.25 horn-to-booster connecting stud and fat life requirements.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for ultrasonic tooling geometry
Shot peening Almen with 0.5mm corner radius
Black oxide/DLC coating with 0.5mm corner radius
CMM SPC dimensional check with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for m12x125 horntobooster connecting application
commonFailures: Corrosion pitting in road salt exposure - mitigated by DLC 2um 15GPa + hot wax sealant — critical for m12x125 horntobooster connecting performance

faq.q: What weight-to-strength ratio does Titanium Ultrasonic Connecting Stud offer over steel?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130/4340 steel at equivalent strength: 4.43 g/cm³ vs 7.85 g/cm³ with 830 MPa yield. For m12x125 horntobooster connecting, this translates directly to reduced unsprung mass (suspension) or reduced reciprocating mass (valvetrain), improving both acceleration response and fatigue-limited component life by 2-3×.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Ultrasonic Connecting Stud orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Ultrasonic Connecting Stud is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Ultrasonic Connecting Stud?
faq.a: Each Titanium Ultrasonic Connecting Stud shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for m12x125 horntobooster connecting.
